scope: Audit weighting and endogenous record counts only; no entries, stops, targets, tuning, candidate resurrection or independent holdout claim.
sample: Same 435 complete RTH days and exact 454 scheduled-session masks as the published raw-market study, Dec30 2024-Sep30 2026; reload all69 registered CSVs. No new date/subgroup filtering.
event_definition: Strict new running RTH high/low from second bar. Event known at minute close. Signed forward log-bps after that close over15m,60m,and final RTH close. Same horizon censoring as published. No PDH/PDL expansion.

schemes.event: Sum all outcomes / total number of eligible events.
schemes.equal_day: For each event day first S_d/N_d, then equal-weight event days. N_d is the FINAL number of horizon-eligible records, not known at event time.
schemes.past_count: Weight kth eligible record by1/k using only current/past count; pool weighted outcomes over all days and divide by pooled sum of1/k. No end-of-day per-day renormalization. Diagnostic estimator, not a trading rule.
schemes.first_record: First eligible record per event day only. Its occurrence is a stopping time before horizon cutoff. Diagnostic estimator, not a proposed filter or trading rule.

algebra: On days N>0, event_mean - equal_day_mean = population_Cov(N, S/N) / mean(N). Exact finite-sample identity; no causal fraction of an edge is identified.
exact_control: Enumerate all256 equally likely 8step independent symmetric+/-1 log-increment paths; OHLC endpoints include minute open and close. Discard first bar as record baseline. Compare1step and remaining-to-final horizons. Independent scalar oracle versus vectorized estimator; no market data or parameter fit.

null_generators.name: gaussian_iid
null_generators.description: Independent zero-mean Gaussian log increments,8 independent substeps/minute and390 minutes/day. Constant minute variance equals observed pooled RTH realized variance/390. No drift; conditional expected future log return is0.

null_generators.name: gaussian_clock_scale
null_generators.description: Same zero-mean independent Gaussian substeps;13 fixed halfhour variance factors calibrated from real squared close increments, plus independent empirical daily RV-scale draws normalized to unit second moment. Volatility varies, conditional mean remains0.

null_generators.name: conditional_bar_reflections
null_generators.description: For every observed bar, reflect its full open/high/low/close log-offset shape around previous close by an independent fair sign. Concatenate reflected close increments. Actual magnitude/wick/time/day patterns fixed, directions randomized. Conditional simulated future close increments have mean0. No assertion this is an exact NQ data-generating process.

real_uncertainty.method: Independent implementation of chronological circular5session block bootstrap with454 scheduled-session rows and original missing masks
real_uncertainty.ci: Nominal percentile95 for all24 estimator means and6 paired event-minus-day differences; no new zero p-values here

monte_carlo_comparison.family: 3 generators *2 record sides *3 horizons *4 schemes, one global Holm72 adjustment
monte_carlo_comparison.interval: Report null P05/P25/P50/P75/P95 and2.5/97.5 predictive quantiles, plus MC standard error of null mean. NOT a confidence interval for observed effect.
monte_carlo_comparison.interpretation: Gaussian parameters are calibrated on consumed NQ data, so plug-in simulation tail comparisons are approximate model checks, not exact confirmatory p-values or independent validation. Conditional-reflection validity requires sign-reflection invariance. Holm does not repair model misspecification.

zero_test_calibration.panels: First128 independent experiments, never selected by results
zero_test_calibration.adjustment: Original43family with12 record tests and31 placeholder p=1; conservative with respect to other tests. Also report nominal per-cell rates and95Wilson MC intervals.
zero_test_calibration.terminology: Frequency of rejecting zero under a no-predictability generator, NOT type-I error for the equal-day estimand: its true expectation can legitimately be nonzero.

reproduction: Independently reload/re-extract record events and compare dates, times, counts, returns and two old means to private published evidence and public summaries. Exact enumeration versus scalar oracle. Save fixed-seed experiment arrays and hashes, deterministic aggregate export; no repeat-until-significant.
limits: All NQ data already consumed; no new validation claim
No universal percentage of market effect explained can be identified from3 illustrative null models
Conditional associations and ex-post weights do not establish executable predictability
5session bootstrap cannot guarantee stationarity or capture all long memory
Finite MC tail resolution and calibrated null uncertainty must be reported
Old archive and published raw-market results remain byte-identical
